name: Nexis CRO
summary: Shopify app that runs a 34-check SEO and AEO audit across products, collections, pages and policies, rewrites the gaps with AI, deploys JSON-LD schema and an llms.txt file, and tracks whether ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity cite your store.
best_for: Shopify merchants who already care about being cited in ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity, and who want the audit, the schema deployment, the llms.txt file and the citation tracking in one app instead of stitching them together.
skip_if: you already run a mature SEO app, you want proven tooling rather than a new one, or AI-chat visibility is not yet a business question for your store
honest_knock:
It has no track record at all. The app launched on 9 June 2026 and its App Store listing still showed a 0.0 rating from zero reviews when we read it on 14 September and again on 3 October 2026, so every claim about what the audit catches, how good the AI rewrites are and whether the citation tracking is accurate rests on the vendor's own description. That matters more than usual here, because AEO tracking is a young field: nobody has yet shown that being cited by ChatGPT or Perplexity moves revenue, and the numbers a tracker reports are hard for a merchant to check independently. The free tier is also thin: 5 AI credits and one audit a month is enough to see the interface, not to test the product.

Who is behind it is thinly documented. The listing gives the developer as Nexis Cro with an address in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, the app is English-only, and nexiscro.com links a privacy policy but no terms of service or refund policy. The privacy policy (8 June 2026) names OpenAI as the processor for AI requests, using models such as GPT-4o-mini, so product and policy text you send through AI Quick Fix leaves Shopify for OpenAI. The listing's data-access block asks for the store owner's name, email, phone number and address and for customer device and geolocation data.

The vendor's own pages also disagree on price: the llms.txt file lists Pro at $29, Growth at $59 and Agency at $149, three times the listing's $9, $21 and $44. An AEO vendor whose own machine-readable file misstates its prices is a small but telling signal about how carefully the llms.txt it deploys to your store needs checking.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Pro · per month, or $99 a year
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-17 on apps.shopify.com/nexis-cro-ai-seo-aeo-audit and in our own test that day; earlier: read 14 September 2026 and re-read unchanged on 3 October 2026 on apps.shopify.com/nexis-cro-ai-seo-aeo-audit) Free, then Pro $9 a month or $99 a year, Growth $21 or $121, and Agency $44 or $344. All charges are in USD and recur every 30 days, and the paid tiers carry a 2-day free trial — short for judging a tool whose whole promise is a change in how AI engines see you. The meter is AI credits: Free gives 5 a month and a single audit, Pro 100 with unlimited audits and history, Growth 300, Agency 500. Read Agency's “500 AI credits (unlimited usage)” against that number rather than past it: the credits are the ceiling. The yearly discounts the vendor advertises do hold up when you check them — 8% on Pro, 52% on Growth, 35% on Agency. Re-read on 28 October 2026 with a plain fetch: the Shopify listing is unchanged (Free; Pro $9 or $99 a year; Growth $21 or $121; Agency $44 or $344; 2-day trial on paid plans; charges in USD every 30 days) and still shows no reviews. nexiscro.com repeats those prices and states Agency as $29 a month billed yearly. Its llms.txt file, which AI assistants read, still lists Pro $29, Growth $59 and Agency $149; billing runs through Shopify, so the plan card on the approval screen is the number to check. The site's comparison table fills in the meters: AI Rank Tracker checks per 30 days are 5 on Free (1 prompt), 150 on Pro (5 prompts), 1,200 on Growth (20 prompts) and 5,000 on Agency (50 prompts); the AI FAQ Generator covers 3 products on Free, 50 on Pro and unlimited above; a Deep Scan audit costs up to 2 credits and a Full Report 3. Read again on 17 November 2026: the listing is unchanged (Free; Pro $9 or $99 a year; Growth $21 or $121; Agency $44 or $344; a 2 day trial on the paid plans) and still shows no reviews. In our own test the same day on a Shopify development store, Shopify's plan screen offered only the Free plan, marked free to test on this store, with 5 AI credits and 1 audit a month, and showed Pro, Growth and Agency as not available while the store is in development, at the same amounts as the listing. We saw no approval screen for a paid plan. The free audit finished in about ten seconds and gave a store score plus a product readiness score of 32 out of 100 across 20 products; the AI description optimiser asked for Pro. We saw no separate JSON-LD or llms.txt check in the free audit, only a schema completeness sub score on each product, and we did not test the AI Rank Tracker or the deployment of schema or llms.txt.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Nexis CRO (AI SEO and AEO audit) on a Shopify development store: the install without a payment screen, the free audit (done after about 10 seconds, about 2 minutes after the install), the Product AEO Center with an average score of 32/100 (Grade D) across 20 products, all graded D or F, the recommendations for The Minimal Snowboard (21/100), the AI Description Optimizer marked PRO required, the plan page with Pro, Growth and Agency marked Not available, and the uninstall dialog, after which the app was uninstalled. Nothing was paid, approved or applied. Install: the app (App Store name Nexis CRO: AI SEO & AEO Audit, developer Nexis Cro, Ho Chi Minh City) was installed from its App Store listing through the install form in our own tab. The form was sent at 22:08, the dialog Install app showed the app and the developer, and Install was clicked at about 22:09. The right app opened. No payment screen, plan choice, card or phone number was asked. A welcome screen offered the choice Improve my store with clear, guided fixes and the button Continue to Overview. Listing: the description says 34-check SEO and AEO audit, with the plans Free, Pro $9 a month ($99 a year), Growth $21 ($121 a year) and Agency $44 ($344 a year), and a rating of 0.0 with 0 reviews. This matches the dossier. Core action: on Overview the button Run first audit (then Run audit) was clicked, with the text Get a baseline AEO score and a prioritized list of fixes in about 30 seconds. It was started at about 22:10 and was done after about 10 seconds; the first finding shown was Fix: Refund policy should be present, called the highest-severity finding. The first result came about 2 minutes after the install and after 3 steps (Continue, Run audit, the result). Product AEO Center (Improve, Product readiness): AVG AEO SCORE 32/100, Grade D, across 20 products, and CRITICAL ISSUES (D/F) 20 products need immediate attention, so all 20 products were graded D or F. The Minimal Snowboard scored 21/100, Grade F, with Schema Completeness 15/30, Content Structure 0/20, FAQ Content 0/15, Description Quality 0/15, Image Alt Text 5/10 and Attribute Completeness 1/10, and the recommendations Missing product type, Missing GTIN/barcode, Missing SKU, Description too short, No list formatting and No numerical specifications. The AI Description Optimizer was marked PRO required and its button was greyed out. Nothing was applied to any product and no store data was changed. A difference from the dossier: the audit showed no separate JSON-LD check and no llms.txt check; Schema Completeness is one partial score of a product. The free audit therefore shows less on those two points than the dossier suggests. Plans: the Shopify plan page (free to test on this store) lists the Free plan with 5 AI credits a month, 1 audit a month, AI Quick Fix & Rewrite, AI Image Alt Text, AI Visibility Scanner (Basic) and AI Rank Tracker (1 prompt, 5 checks). Under Unavailable on dev stores, Pro $99 a year ($9 per 30 days, 2 trial days), Growth $121 a year ($21 per 30 days) and Agency $344 a year ($44 per 30 days) were all marked Not available; the amounts equal the listing. Checkout: no approval screen, test charge screen or card field was seen, because the paid plans cannot be selected on a development store. Nothing was approved. Cancelling: no paid plan was started. In Settings, Apps, Uninstall opened the dialog Uninstall Nexis CRO: AI SEO & AEO Audit?, which says that a request will be sent to the app developer within 48 hours to delete all personal customer information, and a reason is required (Testing multiple apps was chosen). The app was uninstalled at about 22:20 and is gone from the installed apps. Not tested: the AI Rank Tracker (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity), llms.txt, deploying JSON-LD schema, image alt text, Fix this issue, and the paid plans. Clean up: no theme change was made and nothing was applied to the store; the app was uninstalled in Settings, Apps and our own tab was closed. The price fields are not changed here. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The audit showed no separate JSON-LD check and no llms.txt check, only a partial score Schema Completeness, which is less than the dossier suggests for the free audit. The AI rewrite is marked PRO required and the paid plans could not be selected on our development store.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Nexis CRO (AI SEO and AEO audit) on a Shopify development store: the install without a payment screen, the free audit (done after about 10 seconds, about 2 minutes after the install), the Product AEO Center with an average score of 32/100 (Grade D) across 20 products, all graded D or F, the recommendations for The Minimal Snowboard (21/100), the AI Description Optimizer marked PRO required, the plan page with Pro, Growth and Agency marked Not available, and the uninstall dialog, after which the app was uninstalled. Nothing was paid, approved or applied. Install: the app (App Store name Nexis CRO: AI SEO & AEO Audit, developer Nexis Cro, Ho Chi Minh City) was installed from its App Store listing through the install form in our own tab. The form was sent at 22:08, the dialog Install app showed the app and the developer, and Install was clicked at about 22:09. The right app opened. No payment screen, plan choice, card or phone number was asked. A welcome screen offered the choice Improve my store with clear, guided fixes and the button Continue to Overview. Listing: the description says 34-check SEO and AEO audit, with the plans Free, Pro $9 a month ($99 a year), Growth $21 ($121 a year) and Agency $44 ($344 a year), and a rating of 0.0 with 0 reviews. This matches the dossier. Core action: on Overview the button Run first audit (then Run audit) was clicked, with the text Get a baseline AEO score and a prioritized list of fixes in about 30 seconds. It was started at about 22:10 and was done after about 10 seconds; the first finding shown was Fix: Refund policy should be present, called the highest-severity finding. The first result came about 2 minutes after the install and after 3 steps (Continue, Run audit, the result). Product AEO Center (Improve, Product readiness): AVG AEO SCORE 32/100, Grade D, across 20 products, and CRITICAL ISSUES (D/F) 20 products need immediate attention, so all 20 products were graded D or F. The Minimal Snowboard scored 21/100, Grade F, with Schema Completeness 15/30, Content Structure 0/20, FAQ Content 0/15, Description Quality 0/15, Image Alt Text 5/10 and Attribute Completeness 1/10, and the recommendations Missing product type, Missing GTIN/barcode, Missing SKU, Description too short, No list formatting and No numerical specifications. The AI Description Optimizer was marked PRO required and its button was greyed out. Nothing was applied to any product and no store data was changed. A difference from the dossier: the audit showed no separate JSON-LD check and no llms.txt check; Schema Completeness is one partial score of a product. The free audit therefore shows less on those two points than the dossier suggests. Plans: the Shopify plan page (free to test on this store) lists the Free plan with 5 AI credits a month, 1 audit a month, AI Quick Fix & Rewrite, AI Image Alt Text, AI Visibility Scanner (Basic) and AI Rank Tracker (1 prompt, 5 checks). Under Unavailable on dev stores, Pro $99 a year ($9 per 30 days, 2 trial days), Growth $121 a year ($21 per 30 days) and Agency $344 a year ($44 per 30 days) were all marked Not available; the amounts equal the listing. Checkout: no approval screen, test charge screen or card field was seen, because the paid plans cannot be selected on a development store. Nothing was approved. Cancelling: no paid plan was started. In Settings, Apps, Uninstall opened the dialog Uninstall Nexis CRO: AI SEO & AEO Audit?, which says that a request will be sent to the app developer within 48 hours to delete all personal customer information, and a reason is required (Testing multiple apps was chosen). The app was uninstalled at about 22:20 and is gone from the installed apps. Not tested: the AI Rank Tracker (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity), llms.txt, deploying JSON-LD schema, image alt text, Fix this issue, and the paid plans. Clean up: no theme change was made and nothing was applied to the store; the app was uninstalled in Settings, Apps and our own tab was closed. The price fields are not changed here. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The audit showed no separate JSON-LD check and no llms.txt check, only a partial score Schema Completeness, which is less than the dossier suggests for the free audit. The AI rewrite is marked PRO required and the paid plans could not be selected on our development store.
